name: remove-expired-hook
prompt: Ops reports: after sessions expire, /healthz keeps showing them until someone reads that exact id. The root cause is that expiry is enforced lazily inside Get only. Add func (s *Store) RemoveExpired() int to session.go: it deletes every expired session immediately and returns the count. Wire it into main.go so /healthz calls RemoveExpired() before reporting the count, so /healthz always reflects only live sessions. RemoveExpired must be safe for concurrent use.
